# github-legacy-repos

Pointers / snapshots of legacy GitHub repos that fed the lineage. Cross-check
against `inventory/GITHUB_REPOS.md` on `lineage-index`.

## Stack & contents

Three files: `README.md`, `REPOS.json`, `SOURCE_CONTEXT.md`. Inventory of all `TrajanWJ` GitHub repos with private/fork/updated metadata. Lists 11 repos including ema-transfer-pack, proslync-*, place.org, ema, agent-os-demo, Executive, AgentGPT.

## Why this is here

Authoritative GitHub-side counterpart to `lineage-index/inventory/LOCAL_ROOTS.md`. Pair the two when tracing provenance.

## How to load it efficiently

```bash
git show origin/github-legacy-repos:REPOS.json
git show origin/github-legacy-repos:README.md
```
